teams.product_capability: Learned legal distance metric that optimizes nearest-neighbor retrieval for jurist usefulness, exposed as a selectable map mode alongside the validated center_projected baseline and zero-shot citation/outcome hybrids
teams.question: Does a supervised metric learning approach (Mahalanobis/linear metric) trained on Jurivoc descriptors and TF branch/legal_area metadata as weak supervision, fusing the validated center_projected baseline with legal-specific signals (sachverhalt TF-IDF, erwaegungen TF-IDF, norm/article embeddings, citation role weights, cited_decisions_tfidf, outcome_tfidf), produce legally more useful nearest neighbors than the unsupervised center_projected baseline AND the zero-shot cited_decisions_tfidf signal AND the zero-shot cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrids?
teams.hypothesis: A metric learned from Jurivoc/TF weak labels will optimally weight complementary legal signals (facts for legal_area coherence, reasoning for citation proximity, norms for doctrinal proximity, citation roles for precedent proximity, cited decisions for citation heritage, outcomes for cross-lingual alignment) and suppress boilerplate, beating both the unsupervised center_projected baseline AND the zero-shot cited_decisions_tfidf signal AND the zero-shot cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrids on jurist proxy benchmarks (branch_knn, legal_area_clustering, citation_heritage, tf_metadata_human_indexing) while maintaining zoom_coherence and multilingual_invariance.
teams.why_now: CONCRETE EVIDENCE (corrected — verified values only): (1) Evaluation v3 FREEZES center_projected_64dim as validated baseline: passes BOTH adversarial gates (LangDom=0.531<0.85, JP=0.512>0.5). (2) Core legal-distance v6 achieved METRIC LEARNING BREAKTHROUGH on center_projected space: linear projection JP=0.6847, mahalanobis JP=0.6781 (per frozen harness v3 seed=42), both pass BOTH adversarial gates with 18+ consecutive valid epochs. (3) cited_decisions_tfidf (zero-shot citation TF-IDF) achieves jurist preference 0.6922 and language dominance 0.6107 — BEATS supervised metric learning on jurist pairwise WITHOUT training. All 6 cited_decisions_tfidf + center_projected hybrids PASS both gates. (4) v8 holdout validation (FIXED — data leakage corrected): cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5 holdout JP=0.580, LangDom=0.511. PASS adversarial gates but do NOT meet factory JP>0.7 target. (5) Legal-distance v4 ACCEPTED reveals COMPLEMENTARY signal strengths: section_sachverhalt wins legal_area (NMI 0.4782, purity 0.8571); section_erwaegungen wins citation_proximity (AUC 0.6562). (6) Corpus provides weak supervision: Jurivoc descriptors + TF branch/legal_area metadata on 1000+ decisions. (7) Fractal-map validated (hierarchical Leiden nesting=1.0, purity=0.9571) provides evaluation harness. (8) Statute extractor maps 43 laws; citation graph has 2105 refs. (9) Legal-distance v5 REPRODUCED: scale test confirms generalization, legal embeddings reveal trade-offs, citation roles provide new signal dimension. (10) Citation role modeling UNBLOCKED: BGE/ATF citation resolution FIXED — 100% of 2,988 role annotations resolved. (11) v14 REPRODUCED (independent seed=137): linear_citation_concat mean_delta=+0.0392, paired_std=0.0212 → PASS on 5-fold CV, promoted to REPRODUCED tier. (12) v12 temporal holdout REPLICATED: linear_hybrid05_concat JP=0.8375 beats center_projected_64dim JP=0.7750 by +0.0625 on temporal test set. (13) True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 (v11 clean OOS); factory JP>0.7 target NOT met by any representation. (14) Two-mode tradeoff persists: all JP-winning combinations sacrifice CiteIndep.
teams.non_duplication: Core legal-distance lane performs UNSUPERVISED signal ablation (systematic combination/weighting of legal signals against frozen baseline) AND METRIC LEARNING on center_projected space (linear + Mahalanobis projections). This team pursues SUPERVISED METRIC LEARNING on weak labels (Jurivoc/TF metadata) fusing MULTIPLE legal signals — fundamentally different methodology. Core lane asks 'what learned metric on center_projected space optimizes jurist proxies?'; this team asks 'what learned metric optimally fuses center_projected + cited_decisions_tfidf + outcome_tfidf + legal signals for jurist proxy objectives using Jurivoc supervision?'. Independent path: Jurivoc-supervised multi-signal fusion vs. center_projected-space metric learning. PAUSED because zero-shot hybrids (JP=0.580, LangDom=0.511 on holdout) pass adversarial gates but do NOT meet factory JP>0.7 target — product capability not yet achieved by any approach; frontier recharter only if Jurivoc-supervised multi-signal fusion shows credible path toward JP>0.7.

teams.product_capability: Cross-lingually aligned legal embeddings that achieve language dominance < 0.51 (beating cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5 holdout at 0.511) while preserving coarse legal structure and fractal hierarchy, exposed as a 'Cross-Lingual Legal' map mode for multilingual Swiss case law navigation
teams.question: Does CPU-feasible fine-tuning (LoRA/distillation) of multilingual-e5-small on the Swiss Federal Supreme Court corpus with (a) hierarchy preservation loss, (b) Jurivoc/TF branch-legal_area contrastive pairs, and/or (c) citation-heritage positive pairs produce embeddings that achieve adversarial_language_dominance < 0.51 AND jurist_pairwise_preference > 0.58 AND cross_language_retrieval > 0.2, while maintaining zoom_coherence improvement_rate >= 0.39 and fractal hierarchy (no collapse) on the frozen evaluation harness?
teams.hypothesis: multilingual-e5-small pretrained achieves BEST adversarial scores (LangDom=0.4877, JP=0.7017) but CATASTROPHICALLY COLLAPSES fractal hierarchy (1 coarse → 1000 fine clusters, hier_adv=0.0). A CPU-feasible LoRA fine-tuning with hierarchy preservation loss (e.g., triplet loss on Leiden coarse/fine structure) can retain the superior cross-lingual alignment while restoring multi-resolution legal map structure. This is an independent path from metric learning (operates on native 384-dim multilingual space vs projected 64/128/768-dim) and zero-shot hybrids (unsupervised, no training).
teams.why_now: CONCRETE ACCEPTED EVIDENCE (corrected — verified values only): (1) BOILERPLATE RESISTANCE CORRECTION (REPRODUCED tier): Real test shows 89-93% neighbor preservation when boilerplate removed — boilerplate NOT driving neighbors. v3 'boilerplate_resistance' proxy MISNAMED; measured language dominance (cross-lingual alignment failure). SYSTEMIC CHALLENGE IS CROSS-LINGUAL ALIGNMENT. (2) Legal embeddings CATASTROPHICALLY FAIL out-of-box: multilingual-e5-small, MiniLM, xlm-roberta all achieve LangDom ~1.0 on frozen harness v3 (seed=42). (3) v8 holdout validation (FIXED): cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5 holdout LangDom=0.511, JP=0.580 — PASS adversarial gates but do NOT meet factory JP>0.7 target. (4) multilingual-e5-small pretrained achieves BEST adversarial scores (LangDom=0.4877, JP=0.7017) but CATASTROPHIC hierarchy collapse — proves base architecture has superior cross-lingual legal signal. (5) GPU unavailable >2 director review cycles — stop_promote_rule triggered; team PAUSED. (6) CPU-feasible LoRA/distillation variant INITIATED as recharter path. (7) Unsupervised cross-lingual alignment (proc_pairs, joint_pca) validated in core lane v7/v9: proc_pairs (LangDom=0.6799, Jurist=0.6981, Jurivoc_L0=0.3133 PASS, cross-lang=0.2083 PASS), joint_pca (LangDom=0.6237, Jurist=0.6472, cross-lang=0.2066 PASS). Supervised fine-tuning must beat these AND verified baselines to justify investment. (8) True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 (v11 clean OOS); factory JP>0.7 target NOT met by any representation. (9) v14 REPRODUCED: linear_citation_concat stable cross-mode combination confirmed. (10) v12 temporal holdout REPLICATED: cross-mode combinations generalize to future decisions.
teams.non_duplication: Core legal-distance lane does UNSUPERVISED signal ablation + metric learning ON center_projected space (64/128/768-dim). This team does CPU-feasible FINE-TUNING of a multilingual foundation model (multilingual-e5-small, native 384-dim) on Swiss legal corpus with HIERARCHY PRESERVATION LOSS — fundamentally different representation space and objective. Core lane optimizes metric on existing embeddings; this team learns NEW embeddings with cross-lingual legal invariance AND fractal hierarchy baked in. Independent path: foundation model fine-tuning with hierarchy loss vs. metric learning on fixed embeddings vs. zero-shot hybrids. Legal-distance v5/v8 already tested off-the-shelf legal embeddings (all fail LangDom ~1.0 or collapse hierarchy); this team tests if LoRA fine-tuning with hierarchy loss fixes BOTH cross-lingual alignment failure AND hierarchy collapse.
